keyword: Skilled Nursing Facility Quality Reporting Program
description: Skilled Nursing Facilities (SNFs) provide Medicare Part A SNF services to beneficiaries and must report data on certain measures of quality to Medicare through the Skilled Nursing Facility Quality Reporting Program (SNF QRP). This file contains a list of SNFs, as well as their results on the quality of resident care measures implemented under the IMPACT Act.
title: Skilled Nursing Facility Quality Reporting Program - Provider Data
